entities.summary: Ottomar Ladva is an Estonian chess player and grandmaster. He is a four-time Estonian Chess Champion . He has also achieved success in high-stakes poker tournaments, such as his €439,400 win in the 2024 PokerStars European Poker Tour Barcelona.
